title: preflightCli Test 2 moved to spawnRailedChild; a wrong override key corrected to ETH_WS_URL
severity_rationale: The old key was silently a no-op; the correction makes the override real.

evidence.note: Child now started through spawnRailedChild with envOverrides. Override key ETH_WS_RPC_URL corrected to ETH_WS_URL. Assertions unchanged. Reason: D-03: no child env from the parent. ETH_WS_RPC_URL is a key the code never reads (src/chainRegistry.ts:211 reads ETH_WS_URL) and it is not a test/.env.test key, so spawnRailedChild refuses it. The old override was silently a no-op.

sibling_sites_checked: Every entry of rails-test-edits.json is registered individually or merged with its discovery. The diff of test/integration/preflightCli.test.ts was re-read against audit_base_sha.
